title: Com2uS Pushes Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint Game to 2028
content:
Com2uS, a Korean gaming company, has delayed its Omniscient Reader’s Viewpoint game to 2028, a year later than the 2027 window the company had previously pointed to in May, according to its second-quarter 2026 earnings presentation released on August 12.

The updated materials list the title — developed by Offbeat for PC and console, with a global release excluding China — now slated for 2028.

The delay follows Com2uS' original announcement of the game in March 2025, when the company secured publishing rights to the franchise. Com2uS has not stated a reason for the shift.

While the presentation from Com2uS stated the anime adaptation of Omniscient Reader’s Viewpoint was also slated for 2028, this has not been officially confirmed by major distributors or production partners, leaving its status uncertain for now.

Thanks to Link20XX for the news tip.

title: Record of Lodoss War: Queen of Death Webtoon Launches in English
content:
KADOKAWA announced on August 4 the global release of Record of Lodoss War : Queen of Death , the first webtoon from Studio White , a joint production studio established by KADOKAWA , LINE Digital Frontier , and REDICE STUDIO .

The webtoon launched in English and other languages on July 31 across LINE Manga, ebookjapan, and global WEBTOON platforms in more than 150 countries and regions.

Based on Ryo Mizuno 's classic Record of Lodoss War fantasy series, Queen of Death is an official spin-off set before the original story, following the fall of the Kingdom of Kastuul on the island of Lodoss. The series originally launched in South Korea in May.

Southern Camel is credited with the adaptation, with Blanton providing the artwork.

Fans can read the English version of the series on WEBTOON .

title: One Piece x SpongeBob SquarePants Crossover Confirms American Arrival
content:
Earlier this summer, we here at ComicBook.com reported on an official anime crossover that many were shocked to see was becoming a reality. While many anime events might only be exclusive to Japan, this particular crossover has confirmed that it is making its way to North America. Later this year, Nickelodeon’s most popular NickToon and Eiichiro Oda’s characters are performing a fusion dance of their own as SpongeBob SquarePants characters are receiving a Grand Line makeover. Later this month, batten down the hatches as the Krusty Krab’s fry cook will hit Happy Meals in a U.S. first.

An official SpongeBob SquarePants/One Piece crossover will see the cast of the Nickelodeon series sporting new outfits and, in some cases, new powers as part of McDonald’s Happy Meals. While a specific release date for America hasn’t been revealed, the new toys will make their way to the fast-food establishments later this month. With the crossover rolling out in North America, several other countries are getting in on the action, though, ironically enough, a major nation has been absent. In the latest press release that shared the new crossover art, Japan was confirmed not to receive the crossover, which makes for quite the twist considering how the country has been the premier spot for anime exclusives such as this in the past. You can check out the new poster, along with the crossover Happy Meal figures below.

The Future For SpongeBob & Luffy

With this being the first time that these two franchises are meeting via an official crossover, it’s almost a surprise that it’s taken this long for the West to meet the East in this way, considering both series’ popularity. To start, the Nickelodeon franchise has been running for decades, and it seems as though SpongeBob SquarePants won’t be taking a bow anytime soon. Earlier this summer, Paramount confirmed that not only was the series renewed for seasons eighteen and nineteen , but The Patrick Star Show also had future seasons in the works. Ironically, there has yet to be an official SpongeBob anime, though fans have taken matters into their own hands as various SquarePants fan-made anime projects have gone viral in recent years.

On the anime side of the equation, One Piece might be in the throes of its final saga, but shonen fans still don’t know the end date for Luffy and his crew’s grand finale. Both the manga and anime adaptation are currently focusing on the Straw Hats as they explore the giant island of Elbaph, but these are far from the only projects for Luffy. Netflix is currently working on the third season of the live-action One Piece, with Wit Studio working to release a remake of the source material, with a new anime landing next year. Whether you prefer Bikini Bottom or the Grand Line, it’s a great time to be a fan of both.

title: Manga Up! Global Adds Transmigrated to the Northern Frontier Manga
content:
Square Enix 's Manga UP! Global service has added You Midorikawa 's Transmigrated to the Northern Frontier ( Tensei-saki wa Kita no Henkyō Deshita ga Seirei no Okage de Kekkō Kaiteki Desu: Rakuen Mezashite Shuryō Kaitaku Tokidoki Sauna ) manga, the adaptation of Fuurou 's light novel series with the same title, on Friday.

Manga UP! Global describes the story:

Hunt, Harmonize, Harvest—that's what slow life means in this freezing snowscape! Orphaned as a child, Vito only remembers life being raised in a cold northern village. However, that changes during his coming-of-age ceremony when he suddenly regains memories of his past life as a modern Japanese person—and finds out he's been reincarnated to save this world! With the help of the spirit Shefi and his ""workshop,"" Vito strives to improve the lives of his fellow villagers. Before long, his reputation among the locals skyrockets—especially with Alrich, the young woman who leads the village. Thus begins an otherworldly nomadic fantasy living alongside fluffy animals in the great outdoors!

Midorikawa launched the manga on the Manga UP! website in July 2024. Yūsuke Takahashi is credited for composition. The manga recently ended on April 8. Square Enix published the manga's fourth and final compiled book volume on June 5.

Fuurou launched the original story on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website in 2023. Square Enix published the novels' first volume with illustration by Lard in January 2024, and the second volume in July that same year.

title: WIT STUDIO Teases Attack on Titan Announcement for August 20 With Special Dinner Visual
content:
WIT STUDIO is teasing a new Attack on Titan announcement for August 20, 2026, revealing a visual featuring six characters from the series. The franchise recently got a special visual by MAPPA for the studio’s 15th anniversary , along with confirming new animation for the upcoming Attack on Titan 3 game.

The teaser visual was shared with the message:

“It seems that they, during ‘that period,’ will be holding a special dinner.”

The visual features Eren Jeager, Mikasa Ackerman, Armin Arlert, Levi Ackerman, Erwin Smith, and Hange Zoë, with the date August 20, 2026 displayed at the bottom.

No further details about the project or announcement have been revealed. The wording refers to the characters during “that period” or “that phase” and describes a “special dinner,” although what this specifically refers to will remain unknown until the announcement.

Hajime Isayama wrote and illustrated the Attack on Titan manga, which was serialized in Kodansha’s Bessatsu Shonen Magazine from September 2009 to April 2021. Its chapters were compiled into 34 volumes. The TV anime adaptation was animated by WIT Studio for the first 3 seasons, after which MAPPA took over. The anime ran for a total of 94 episodes, with the final episodes (88-94) streamed as the two Final Chapters specials.

The Final Chapters were compiled into the THE LAST ATTACK movie with improved visuals and sound. It premiered in Japan on November 8 to mostly positive reviews, also introducing a new post-credit scene . The movie exceeded 1 billion yen in revenue on December 5, with international screenings starting in early 2025. Crunchyroll began streaming the movie on April 17, 2025.

Producer Tetsuya Kinoshita recently teased new upcoming projects for the anime, including plans for new films and collaborations.

title: One Piece novel Zoro Tops Oricon's Monthly Light Novel Ranking for July 2026
content:
Writer Jun Esaka and artist Nakamaru's ONE PIECE novel ZORO ranked at #1 with 47,965 copies. Shueisha published the novel on July 3. The novel depicts Zoro's life and adventures before meeting Luffy. Esaka also wrote the One Piece: Heroines light novel series with illustration by Sayaka Suwa . Viz Media publishes the novels in English. The light novels' anime adaptation debuted on July 5.

The sixth volume of Mo Xiang Tong Xiu's Heaven Official's Blessing novel ranked second with 24,807 copies sold. The novel was first published online starting in 2017. Funimation simultaneously streamed the novel's Chinese animated series adaptation in 2020, and released an English dub in 2021.

The ninth volume of Takibi Amamori and Imigimuru 's Make Heroine ga Ooisugiru! ( Too Many Losing Heroines! ) light novel series ranked third with 18,785 copies sold. Amamori released the first volume of the novel series in July 2021 under Shogakukan 's Gagaga Bunko light novel label, with illustrations by Imigimuru . The novel won the 15th Shogakukan Light Novel Award in 2020. Seven Seas licensed both the light novel series and Itachi 's manga adaptation, which launched on Shogakukan 's Manga ONE service in April 2022. The first season of the novels' anime adaptation premiered in July 2024. Crunchyroll streamed the series as it aired. The anime is getting a second season.

title: OceanVeil Adds Yomu's Miru Tights Short Anime Series
content:
WWWave Corporation 's anime streaming platform OceanVeil announced on Tuesday that it is adding the Miru Tights web anime on Thursday at 9:00 p.m. EDT. OceanVeil describes the anime:

Created by legendary illustrator Yom , famous for their obsessive, hyper-realistic depiction of pantyhose aesthetics, Miru Tights is an unashamed celebration of legwear in all its glory. Whether you are a fan of 30-denier sheer elegance, 60-denier matte allure, or the heartbreaking drama of a sudden snag in a thread, OceanVeil invites you to indulge your sophisticated tastes without judgment.

The anime debuted on the Nico Nico Channel and d Anime Store services in May 2019. The official YouTube channel for the anime also streamed the episodes with English subtitles, as well as Traditional Chinese and Simplified Chinese subtitles. The anime streamed 12 five-minute episodes, and the anime's Blu-ray Disc release in Japan included a bonus 13th episode (the release also included the same subtitle language support as the streaming release).

Yūki Ogawa ( Ōya-san wa Shishunki! ) directed the anime at Yokohama Animation Lab and Fumiaki Maruto ( White Album 2 visual novel, Classroom Crisis , Saekano: How to Raise a Boring Girlfriend ) wrote the series. Yukari Hibino designed the characters, and SHADE composed the music. The three cast members each sang their own solo version of the anime's ending theme song "True Days" as their respective characters.

Yomu / Yom , an illustrator whose work typically focuses on women in tights, wrote the original story.

The author's Ganbare Dōki-chan (You Can Do It Dōki-chan) dōjinshi manga also inspired a net anime adaptation that debuted on the ABEMA streaming service in Japan in September 2021. Crunchyroll streamed the anime.

title: Canceled HBO Max Series is Coming to Toonami
content:
In the era of streaming, it seems as though there is so much content out there that subscribers might feel like they can never catch up. Unfortunately, this same benefit can mean that some animated series can be lost in the shuffle. In 2023, Warner Bros added a thought-provoking, stunning show to its HBO Max catalogue that only received one season, much to the chagrin of many viewers. Following its series finale on the streaming service, the show would find new life on Netflix, and now, the animated alien world filled with scavengers is making its way to Cartoon Network’s Toonami in a wild twist.

Beginning next month, on September 5th, Scavengers Reign will arrive on Toonami, which is good news for many fans of the now-defunct series. The series, which focuses on an unfortunate crew stranded on a beautiful but deadly alien world, recently left Netflix earlier this year after a short-lived stint on the streaming service. Ever since the show was originally canceled, many fans have been trying to start a campaign to see the show revived with new seasons. While the efforts so far have been unsuccessful, there’s always the possibility that Scavengers Reign’s Toonami reign could be just what the animated show needs to make a comeback. You can see the announcement with a new trailer below.

Will Scavengers Reign Return?

The true tragedy of Scavengers Reign was that the creators of this unique animated series did have ideas for what the future would look like for the series. In a conversation with us here at ComicBook.com back in 2023 , executive producers Sean Buckelew and James Merrill explained that while the first season was meant to be one complete story, they had mapped out future seasons. Merrill confirmed, “I do feel like we tried to tell a complete story, not a puzzle box that tries to lure people back. That being said, we do have some big ideas as to what could come next. I hope that we get to do it because we want to explore what comes next. We only saw a little bit of the planet.”

Buckelew added that the duo had planned for multiple seasons in the future , though the possibility of this happening now seems far less likely. “We have a couple more seasons mapped out and have some very developed ideas for next season should we get to make more. Fingers crossed because we’d like to spend more time with these characters and really see what else the planet has up its sleeve.” Luckily, if you haven’t had the chance to check out this unique animated series and don’t want to wait until next month, Scavengers Reign is still on HBO Max.

title: One Piece Manga Tops Oricon's Monthly Comic Ranking for July 2026
content:
The 115th volume of Eiichiro Oda 's One Piece manga ranked at #1 selling 1,020,422 copies. The volume shipped in Japan on July 3. The One Piece manga has surpassed 600 million copies published worldwide as of the release of the 114th volume on March 4. The One Piece anime's Elbaph arc debuted in Japan on April 5. Crunchyroll is streaming the arc, and will stream the English dub this fall.

The 39th volume of Yoshihiro Togashi 's Hunter X Hunter manga ranked at #2. The latest volume, its first volume in 22 months, shipped in Japan on July 3. The manga resumed serialization on June 29.

The 17th volume of Nekokurage 's manga adaptation of Hyuganatsu 's The Apothecary Diaries ( Kusuriya no Hitorigoto ) light novels ranked at #3. Nekokurage launched the manga in Square Enix 's Monthly Big Gangan magazine in May 2017. Square Enix Manga publishes the series in English.

title: From Overshadowed to Overpowered Anime Casts Sora Amamiya
content:
The staff for the anime of Kentarou 's From Overshadowed to Overpowered ( Rakudai Kenja no Gakuin Musō: Nidome no Tensei, S-Rank Cheat Majutsushi Bōkenroku ) manga revealed on Thursday that the anime has cast Sora Amamiya as the character Tatiana, Anastasia's older sister. The character will appear in the anime's eighth episode on August 19.

The anime premiered on the d Anime Store , ABEMA , and U-NEXT streaming services in Japan on June 25 at 24:00 (effectively, June 26 at midnight). It then started on the Tokyo MX channel on July 1 at 24:00 (effectively, July 2 at midnight), and also runs on ABC TV, BS Fuji , and WOWOW in Japan. Crunchyroll streams the anime simultaneously with the Japanese stream.

The anime stars:

• Shūichirō Umeda as Ephtal

• Reo Osanai as Anastasia

• Haruka Shiraishi as Marin

• Hiroki Tōchi as Ephtal (as a sage and old man)

• Ayaka Fukuhara as Ephtal (as a youth)

• Emiri Katō as Iria

• Daisuke Hirakawa as Fraser

• Shinichirō Kamio as Abe

• Rina Kawaguchi as Maria

• Hiroki Takahashi as Majin (Genie)

Hisashi Ishii ( Kuma Kuma Kuma Bear , I'm Quitting Heroing , The Unaware Atelier Master ) is directing the anime at EMT Squared , with Deko Akao ( Higehiro , Komi Can't Communicate , Flying Witch ) supervising the series' scripts. Hideki Furukawa ( WATAMOTE , Strike The Blood III onward, Ayakashi Triangle ) is designing the characters.

Rock band FLOW performs the opening theme song "+Encount," and the group TrySail is performing the anime's ending theme song "Dōkei" (Aspiration).

Comikey is releasing the manga in English, and it is also available through Square Enix 's Manga UP! Global service. Comikey describes the manga's story:

Ephtal is reincarnated as a human, coming from modern Earth. In this new world where magic is real, he decides to devote the entirety of his life in the pursuit of magic. Despite his efforts, though, he discovers that he is absolutely talentless in magic, and breathed his last in anguish....But it isn't the end for him just yet! He reincarnates once again bearing the same name, Ephtal, 400 years later. Having retained his knowledge and power, he steels his resolve and once again sets his sights for the peak of magic!

The manga is itself based on Arata Shiraishi 's Rakudai Kenja no Gakuin Musō: Nido Tensei Shita Saikyō Kenja, 400-nen-go no Sekai o Maken de Musō light novel series. The anime is adapting Kentarou 's manga, and specifically uses the manga's slightly different title.

Kentarou launched the manga in Square Enix 's Manga UP! website in September 2019. Square Enix published the manga's ninth compiled book volume on July 7.

Arata Shiraishi originally published the story in a web novel format, before Kadokawa published the first print volume in October 2019, with illustrations by uodenim . Kadokawa published the eighth novel volume in March 2022.
